section_summary.extract_value: This section presents bivariate and ANCOVA analyses comparing body appreciation between bisexual and other sexual minority women. The analyses tested for confounding variables (age, BMI, education, sexual relationship status) and found no significant differences in BAS scores between the two groups when controlling for sexual relationship status, with both groups showing similar adjusted mean body appreciation scores (bisexual M = 3.73, other sexual minority M = 3.69).
